chapter: Postwar records, Miami and Los Angeles
title: Bringing Rene Hernandez from Cuba
summary: With the army taking pianists, Curbelo's father recommended Rene; Machito's sister contacted him and he joined the union and Mario's household.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Okay, you had Joe Loco and he was drafted, I guess you had a lot of good piano players here in the United States. Why did you send for Rene Hernandez?

Because we ran out of pianists because the army has stole practically every good musician. All those that was in the age that could be drafted, so we were losing musicians. Every month we were losing musicians.
So you hadheard of Rene Hernandez, right?
Right. You know who recommend me Rene Hernandez? Jose Curbelo's father.
I see.
He told Mario: "Mario, is a pianist in Cuba, he is a great kid, a good musician and very reliable".
All right. How did you contact Rene ?

Well, I wrote a letter to my sister in Cuba and she contacted Rene. My father, he had the - he hit the lottery. In those days you need certain amont of money to come to the United States ...... as a resident.
END TAPE II
So, did he answered your letter?
Yes, he answered and we fill up all the affidavits and money in the bank and took him about three months, a few months to come.
To come here, right. Do you remember the very first time you met Rene Hernandez?
Oh, yes. Mario, you know, he ......
Tell me about it.

....he always was laughing and a good nature, so we was working in La Conga, so he just came and say: "Hello" ha, ha, ha, you know, laughing thing, and he says --- Well, and the next day we went to the union, on account that he was resident. Everything, everything was in order and Mario had a good reputation, we had a good reputation in the Union so he joined the union and start working with us and in four or five days he was working.
So it took him a week before he got to work with your band.
Right.
He needed the union card and everything.
Uh - Huh
Who did he live with?
He used to live with Mario, with Mario Bauza, Mario's house.
Where was Mario living at that time?
106th and -- Columbus, between 106 and 107.
Where is he living at now?
In the same place.
